1.18.0

Improvements

  • Restore Intel Mac support with a Universal package containing arm64 and x86_64 for the app, widgets and updater helpers.
  • The CLI and MCP share the Universal executable. Use the same download on either chip family, with macOS 14 or later.
  • Retain the 1.17.1 performance improvements, events, lists and widget settings, using the existing signed in-app update feed.

Developer preview. Not notarized by Apple.

1.18.0

改进

  • 恢复 Intel Mac 支持，提供同时包含 arm64 与 x86_64 的通用安装包；主应用、小组件和更新助手均保留两种架构。
  • CLI 与 MCP 使用同一通用可执行文件，无需按芯片选择安装包；继续支持 macOS 14 及更新系统。
  • 保留 1.17.1 的性能优化、事件数据、列表和小组件设置；应用内更新沿用现有签名更新源。

开发预览版，尚未经过 Apple 公证。
